answer: Gate each river-monitoring agent's voting seat with fresh proof of work. Publish an unpredictable epoch beacon and accept a nonce only if the hash of beacon, public key and nonce meets a fixed difficulty within a ten-minute horizon. Binding the puzzle to the key prevents reusing one solution for aliases: N seats require N separate searches. Even at a token-price nadir, computation is still required. This prices extra identities rather than proving distinct owners; efficient hardware retains an advantage.
